description: This file contains implementation of string conversion functions between UTF-8, UTF-16, and ASCII, including utility functions for appending code points and performing UTF conversions, primarily used within the Chromium project.

methods.name: UTF8ToUTF16
methods.description: Converts UTF-8 encoded string to UTF-16 string.

methods.name: UTF16ToUTF8
methods.description: Converts UTF-16 string to UTF-8 encoded string.

methods.name: ASCIIToUTF16
methods.description: Converts ASCII string to UTF-16 string.

methods.name: UTF16ToASCII
methods.description: Converts UTF-16 string to ASCII string.
